# java.library `processors`: an annotation processor from the lockfile
# generates a class the library uses. A processor that is merely on the
# class path doesn't run.
[!exec:javac] skip

# The processor, built here and served from a file:// repository.
bit processor
cp processor/build/processor.jar repo/com/example/hello-processor/1.0/hello-processor-1.0.jar

bit app
stdout 'deps ✔ ok'
stdout 'app ✔ ok'
exec jar tf app/build/app.jar
stdout '^demo/Main\.class$'
stdout '^demo/MainGreeting\.class$'
! stdout '\.java$'
exec java -cp app/build/app.jar demo.Main
stdout '\Agenerated hello\n\z'

# Only the processors named run, not one found on the class path.
! bit unprocessed
stdout 'symbol: +variable MainGreeting'

-- BUILD.bit --
explicit processor = java.library {
  dir = "processor"
}

deps = java.maven {
  artifacts    = ["com.example:hello-processor:1.0"]
  repositories = ["file://#{project_dir()}/repo"]
}

explicit app = java.library {
  dir        = "app"
  # The processor's jar also holds the annotation the sources use.
  maven      = ["com.example:hello-processor"]
  processors = ["com.example:hello-processor"]
  lock       = deps.lock
}

explicit unprocessed = java.library {
  dir       = "app"
  classpath = ["../processor/build/processor.jar"]
  output    = "build/unprocessed.jar"
}
-- repo/com/example/hello-processor/1.0/hello-processor-1.0.pom --
<project>
  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
  <artifactId>hello-processor</artifactId>
  <version>1.0</version>
</project>
-- processor/src/main/java/hello/HelloProcessor.java --
package hello;

import java.io.Writer;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.annotation.processing.AbstractProcessor;
import javax.annotation.processing.RoundEnvironment;
import javax.annotation.processing.SupportedAnnotationTypes;
import javax.lang.model.SourceVersion;
import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
import javax.lang.model.element.TypeElement;

// Writes `<Class>Greeting` beside every class annotated with @Hello.
@SupportedAnnotationTypes("hello.Hello")
public class HelloProcessor extends AbstractProcessor {
    @Override
    public SourceVersion getSupportedSourceVersion() {
        return SourceVersion.latestSupported();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean process(Set<? extends TypeElement> annotations, RoundEnvironment round) {
        for (TypeElement annotation : annotations) {
            for (Element element : round.getElementsAnnotatedWith(annotation)) {
                TypeElement type = (TypeElement) element;
                String pkg = processingEnv.getElementUtils().getPackageOf(type).getQualifiedName().toString();
                String name = type.getSimpleName() + "Greeting";
                try (Writer out = processingEnv.getFiler().createSourceFile(pkg + "." + name, type).openWriter()) {
                    out.write("package " + pkg + "; public class " + name
                        + " { public static String text() { return \"generated hello\"; } }");
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
-- processor/src/main/java/hello/Hello.java --
package hello;

import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
import java.lang.annotation.Target;

@Retention(RetentionPolicy.SOURCE)
@Target(ElementType.TYPE)
public @interface Hello {
}
-- processor/src/main/resources/META-INF/services/javax.annotation.processing.Processor --
hello.HelloProcessor
-- app/src/main/java/demo/Main.java --
package demo;

@hello.Hello
public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(MainGreeting.text());
    }
}
